messages:
Maria (CSM): Hey team — kicking off the Arcadia Health onboarding. Goal: get Redwood API integrated in staging and a pilot in prod within 30 days. Key ask: confirm owners for each area below and flag any blockers.

Jordan (Success Ops): Thanks — high level success criteria from my side: 1) staging integration with token rotation, 2) end-to-end latency <= 300ms (95th), 3) embeddings match baseline recall on sample set, 4) basic dashboarding enabled for usage/cost.

Sam (Solutions Eng): I can own infra + deployment steps. Need sandbox API key and a sample dataset (anonymized). Also decision on model variant (e.g., redwood-base vs quantized) — which should we recommend for pilot?

Lee (Product): Re: model variant — recommend quantized smaller model for pilot to control cost, fallback to larger if QA needs it. I'll share SLO targets and proposed milestone dates in a separate calendar invite.

Nora (Enablement): I'll run two enablement sessions: dev onboarding (30m) and admin ops (45m). Proposed slate: dev session week 1, admin week 2. I can prepare a quickstart doc and a 5–7 example prompts doc.

Maria (CSM): Owners proposed: integration & infra = Sam, success metrics & dashboards = Jordan, enablement = Nora, product checkpoints = Lee. I'll map into our onboarding board.

Jordan (Success Ops): Operational risks: renewal risk flagged if adoption < 20% of targeted users at 60 days. Suggest we instrument a feedback capture flow: in-app micro-survey + post-session feedback + a short Google form. Also set up an eval harness to detect model regressions on core prompts.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Agreed. For sandbox creds — @Arcadia point-of-contact needs a staging API key and a CORS-friendly endpoint. Example curl we can ship to them:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_STAGE_XXXXX" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"summarize: patient intake notes"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Need someone to provision SK_STAGE_XXXXX and share securely.

Lee (Product): I'll add the SLO table and milestone Gantt to the shared drive. Proposed check-ins: weekly 30-min sync Thursdays at 11am PT, and an engineering deep-dive at day 10.

Nora (Enablement): For training materials I want two inputs: sample prompts + common failure modes. Jordan — can you gather 5 example failure cases from Arcadia?

Jordan (Success Ops): On it. I'll push a small list by EOD today. Also attaching initial customer success plan snippet in the task board.

DeployBot: staging-environment: created and ready — host: staging.arcadia.redwood.internal, status: :white_check_mark:.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Great, DeployBot. I'll attempt an integration smoke test tomorrow morning. If we hit auth errors I'll ping infra.

Maria (CSM): Action items summary: 1) Sam — provision sample dataset + run smoke test (owner) 2) Jordan — post failure-case list + wire up feedback form (owner) 3) Nora — prepare quickstart + schedule sessions (owner) 4) Lee — share SLOs + calendar invites (owner) 5) Maria — map to onboarding board & weekly cadence (owner). Please ack/respond with timelines.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Ack — dataset + smoke test by Tue EOD (1735880000-ish).

Jordan (Success Ops): Ack — failure cases + feedback form by EOD today.

Nora (Enablement): Ack — docs draft by Mon, sessions scheduled for Wed (dev) and next Tues (admin).

Lee (Product): Ack — invites sent for weekly syncs and day-10 deep dive.

Maria (CSM): Thanks everyone. I'll create a renewal-risk monitor on the dashboard so we can flag early signals (adoption, queries/day, error rate). If anything blocks you, drop it here or DM. :raised_hands:

Sam (Solutions Eng): One open question: do we want retention of logs in staging for 30 days or 90? For eval/human review I recommend 90 (PII sanitized).

Jordan (Success Ops): Let's go 90 but ensure PII is scrubbed and retention is documented. I'll add to the compliance checklist.

Maria (CSM): Perfect — closing the kickoff thread. Will post the onboarding board link once it's populated.
